subject: Encryption runbook & rotation audit packet request — FinTrust
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fintrust.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: encryption runbook + rotation artifacts for SOC2 review

Hi Logan,

FinTrust is starting an internal control review ahead of our Q3 SOC 2 audit and our security team needs a compact artifact package for Redwood's key management controls. Specifically we need:

- HSM attestation or vendor-signed statement for the HSM instances used for customer tenant keys
- A short, human-readable key rotation runbook (steps to perform a planned rotation, rollback steps, expected operator roles)
- A sampling of rotation manifests (recent window, prefer one live rotation and one emergency rotation) with checksums
- Operator separation matrix and on-call shift logs for the rotation event(s) (redacted as required)
- Any signed wrapkey signatures or key-wrapping audit entries proving KEK wrap/unwrap during the rotation

Can you provide a single packaged packet (PDF + CSV/TSV + signature files) and an attestation email we can include in our control evidence bundle? If you have a preferred link (HubSpot or Drive) where you will upload artifacts, send that too.

We are aiming to close the evidence intake by EOD Monday 2027-04-05. If anything will take longer, please flag it.

Appreciate the help — we can redact operator names but we need the shift timestamps and role mappings.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Sr. Information Security Manager — FinTrust
[Attachment: fintrust_evidence_request_template.xlsx]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fintrust.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: encryption runbook + rotation artifacts for SOC2 review

Team — copying FinTrust to keep visibility. Maria, thanks for the clear checklist. We can assemble the packet; will aim for a single ZIP uploaded to the Drive link and a short cover PDF attestation signed by our Security PM.

Action items for internal owners:
- Marissa: compile HSM attestation PDF(s) and the wrapkey signature file. Include vendor-signed copy if available.
- Jasmine: export rotation manifests for the two requested events (planned rotation 2027-03-07 and emergency rotation 2027-03-21). Provide SHA256 checksums and a small CSV (manifest fields: timestamp, key_id, operator_role, rotation_type, checksum).
- Soojin: grab operator matrix and shift logs; redact PII but keep role mappings and shift timestamps. Add short notes on separation-of-duties controls.

Constraints/notes: do not include raw private key material (obvious), and when providing logs, redact IPs if necessary. For the attestation cover, I will draft a two-paragraph statement confirming processes and sign-off.

Marissa/Jasmine/Soojin — can you confirm ETA? Maria, if Drive upload is acceptable we'll post there and share the link. If you require a DocuSign-signed manifest, say so and we will route for signature.

— Logan
Director, Trust & Security (Redwood Inference)
[Signature]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fintrust.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: encryption runbook + rotation artifacts for SOC2 review

Folks — pulled together the initial artifact set and uploaded to the Drive folder (link below). Highlights:

- redwood_hsm_attestation_20270402.pdf (vendor HSM attestation for HSM cluster IDs used in tenant KEK wrapping) [Attachment stub]
- operator_matrix_20270331.xlsx (role mapping; operator IDs redacted; includes separation-of-duties notes) [Attachment stub]
- rotation_manifest_20270401.csv (two sampled rotations packaged as CSV with sha256_checksum column) [Attachment stub]
- wrapkey_signature_20270401.asc (detached signature of the rotation manifest and KEK wrap log line hashes) [Attachment stub]
- keystore_checksums_20270401.txt (S3 keystore object checksums for the rotation window) [Attachment stub]

A couple of clarifications we added into the cover notes:
- The planned rotation followed the normal rotation runbook; the emergency rotation was initiated by the on-call lead after a detected integrity anomaly and completed with the emergency rollback checklist invoked. Both manifests include an explicit rollback_hash entry.
- TLS termination for tenant traffic occurs at the load balancer layer; we included the TLS cipher inventory excerpt in the attestation PDF as requested.

I also attached a compact runbook excerpt (2 pages) with the core steps (prepare KEK, snapshot, rotate, verify, publish) and the rollback criteria. We did not include any private key material or full shift logs; shift logs contain operator IDs that FinTrust asked to be redacted.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRedacted

ETA for the signed cover attestation: Logan will post the signed PDF by Monday. If FinTrust needs DocuSign, we can route the wrapkey_signature_20270401.asc for an additional signature.

— Marissa
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rotation_manifest_20270401.csv, redwood_hsm_attestation_20270402.pdf, operator_matrix_20270331.xlsx, wrapkey_signature_20270401.asc, keystore_checksums_20270401.txt]

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fintrust.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: encryption runbook + rotation artifacts for SOC2 review

Logan / Marissa — thank you, this is exactly what we needed and the format works for our audit team. Quick follow-ups:

- We will accept the Drive packet and include the provided sha256 checksums in our evidence index.
- Please add an explicit note in the cover attestation that key material was not exported and that all wrap/unwrap operations occurred inside the HSM boundary.
- If possible, add a single signed manifest (PDF) that lists the artifact filenames and their checksums; that makes ingestion easier for our GRC tool.

If you can post the signed manifest to the same Drive location by EOD Monday 2027-04-05 we will mark this intake closed. If you prefer, send a DocuSign link for the manifest and I will have our Security Manager countersign.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

-Maria
Sr. Information Security Manager — FinTrust
[On Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 09:00 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> will follow up with the signed PDF and optional DocuSign link.]
